payload.title: email_render calls the shared renderer package
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** Papyrus keeps Markus conversion and hands an HTML fragment to `caducus-email-render`, so there is one renderer.

**Build.**
`src/papyrus_content/email_render/` becomes a thin wrapper with the same public names; `poetry` dependency added; `amplify/plugins/newsletter/function/requirements.txt` checked. No output change.

**Acceptance.**
`email_render_test.py` passes unchanged, including the test pinning an unbranded theme's markup.

**Related:** kanbus-67de8f
